out_of_scope_files: apps/mobile/src/state/accessStore.ts — under serial group `mobile-billing` which this package holds; minimum wiring so the shipping screens can read server truth: adds `canonicalBilling` (last /v1/billing/sync billing verdict, set only on successful verified sync and cleared with canonicalAccess on failure), `fulfilmentVerdict` (last server disposition bound to this device's own pending record) and the `selectMembershipState` selector. No existing behaviour changed.

apps/mobile/__tests__/wf/PaywallScreen.buttons.test.tsx — the existing member-page accessibility test enumerates the exact set of pressables; the new 'Manage subscription in the App Store' button is added to that expected set (and inherits the existing hit-target assertion). residual_risks: 'grace' is client-observed: the server folds RevenueCat grace periods into the entitlement horizon and never flags 'in grace' explicitly, so the UI's grace state means 'server snapshot still premium while its last verified expiresAt has passed on the device clock' (renewal unconfirmed) — truthful, but not the App Store billing-grace flag itself. Exposing that would need an edge-index (serial group not held) API change.

'expired' from a lapsed horizon relies on canonicalBilling (from the last sync) outliving a fresher canonicalAccess refresh (GET /v1/me/access does not carry expiresAt); when the server returns premium=false it nulls expiresAt, so a lapse first seen via sync renders as 'free' unless a bound expired/refunded verdict exists. No entitlement is ever invented either way.
Apple runtime behaviour (Linking.openURL to apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions on a real device) is UNVERIFIED here by package rule (no Mac runner use); covered by jest mocks only.
Artifacts under artifacts/w07-05/ are gitignored (repo policy) — the uploaded attachment URLs are the durable evidence.

Gap on BASE_SHA 55d80326 (INFERRED from code, then VERIFIED by the failing regression test): (1) apps/mobile/src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx:261-270 derived the 'Pickle Sensei Pro' row only from canonicalAccess (premium → 'Pro active', else free-count / 'Verify access') — no pending, HOLD, grace or expired state, no verified horizon, and no Manage subscription entry anywhere in Settings. (2) apps/mobile/src/screens/PaywallScreen.tsx:444-459 hard-coded 'MEMBERSHIP VERIFIED / Your full court is open.' for any premium snapshot and PaywallScreen.tsx:530-548/753-767 collapsed every non-free situation into a generic 'MEMBERSHIP VERIFICATION' hero keyed on recoveryRequired; while a purchase was pending/on hold the plan cards and prices were still rendered (PaywallScreen.tsx:548 `{plans ? ...}`), i.e. a re-offer of a purchase the server had not settled. (3) apps/mobile/src/state/accessStore.ts kept neither the server billing verdict (`result.billing` from /v1/billing/sync was discarded at accessStore.ts:473) nor the bound fulfilment disposition (accessStore.ts:540-545), so no screen could state a server-verified horizon or an expired/refunded outcome. (4) No App Store subscription-management entry existed (grep for apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions: none).

Fix (reused from r1 after review, cherry-picked onto BASE_SHA as two commits — test 8b8463ea, impl 184af537): new apps/mobile/src/billing/membershipState.ts `describeMembershipState` derives unverified/pending/hold/fulfilled/grace/expired/free strictly from canonicalAccess, canonicalBilling, the pending-fulfilment journal, reconciliation status, the bound fulfilment verdict and billing error codes — never from local StoreKit/RevenueCat state and never with a price; HOLD (journal unreadable, or pending record with server unreachable) outranks pending outranks everything else; a stale premium billing snapshot never grants access the server denies (access.premium false → free/expired). accessStore.ts stores canonicalBilling (set only on a successful verified sync, cleared with canonicalAccess on failure) and fulfilmentVerdict, and exposes selectMembershipState. SettingsScreen renders membership.label and, for signed-in (non-localOnly) members whose state carries manageSubscription, a 'Manage subscription → App Store' row that opens https://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions via Linking.openURL (fallback BrandNotice on failure). PaywallScreen renders state-driven eyebrow/title/detail on the member page plus a 'Manage subscription' secondary button, state-aware hero copy on both non-member pages (paywallCopy.membershipHeroCopy), and withholds plan cards, selected-plan summary, loading/unavailable cards and legal price text while pending/HOLD (offerWithheld). Purchase/restore are still only reachable from the two explicit paywall buttons; nothing new calls StoreKit. Copy checked against docs/APP_STORE_SUBMISSION.md ('Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings'); no Android/Google Play/guest/Live Court/DUPR/competitor/accuracy/superlative wording added.
